title: Going to AeroDef ?  Don’t miss us !
description: Our Executive Director, Stephan Zweidler, will be speaking at AeroDef2019 about Automation-Assisted Work Cells and their advantages as composite component manufacturers integrate automation into historically manual manufacturing processes.
excerpt: Our Executive Director, Stephan Zweidler, will be speaking at AeroDef2019 about Automation-Assisted Work Cells and their advantages as composite component manufacturers integrate automation into historically manual manufacturing processes. Come listen, learn, and ask questions !
